title: Destroyer returns from 11-month-deployment
zh_title: 驱逐舰结束 11 个月的部署返回
summary: 夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。斯普鲁亚
content:
夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。另一艘阿利伯克级驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号在经过 12 个月的部署后于今天返回家园，驻日本的约翰·芬恩号船员被告知预计将进行 13 至 14 个月的部署。正如《防务一号》10 月 22 日报道的那样，海军官员告诉家属，在可预见的未来，部署时间预计为 10 到 10 个月，这与近几十年来典型的 7 个月部署形成鲜明对比。海军最高军士长、海军军士长约翰·佩里曼 (John Perryman) 一周后证实了这一点，并表示至少在未来几年内，10 至 11 个月将成为常态。迈克尔·墨菲号中校表示，“迈克尔·墨菲”号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开夏威夷，穿过南中国海和马六甲海峡，然后到达北阿拉伯海，并在那里度过了大部分部署时间。大卫·尼古拉斯一个月前接任这艘驱逐舰的指挥。
尼古拉斯说，“迈克尔·墨菲”号在“史诗狂怒”行动期间发动了“战斧”导弹袭击，并参与了霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。“我非常自豪能够成为这个团队的一员，”他说。 “这是我有幸共事过的最有韧性的团队。”尼古拉斯此前指挥过另一艘导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号。据海军新闻稿称，当他于 9 月 10 日将掌权交给继任者时，他将成为罗德岛州水面作战学校的教官。但一名海军官员向《国防一号》证实，当“迈克尔·墨菲”号的前任上司中校改变了他的计划。凯特琳·坎宁安 (Caitlin Cunningham) 在执掌约 11 个月后，因“失去信心”而于 9 月 27 日被解职。在周四的返校节上，三等士官杰西·布莱森第一个下船，成为“初吻”抽奖的获胜者。他和妻子阿里安娜·里奥斯站在一起，开玩笑说这次部署涉及“大量的水”。 “加入海军，看看世界——但世界 70% 都是水，”他笑着说。但是，他补充说，工作人员很棒。 “我认为你可以把这艘船上的任何人放在任何其他船上，他们都会脱颖而出，”布莱森说。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii —After a 346-day deployment that included operations in the South China Sea, 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz, 43 replenishments at sea and the removal of its commander 10 months in, the guided-missile-destroyer Michael Murphy returned home Thursday, welcomed by hula dancers and a rainbow stretching over the channel. The ship was attached to the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group for much of its deployment, though the aircraft carrier returned to its home in San Diego on Oct. 8. But any deployment-length records it may have broken were short lived. The Spruance, another Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, returned home today after a 12-month deployment, and the Japan-based John Finn crew has been told to expect a 13- to 14-month deployment. As Defense One reported on Oct. 22, Navy officials have told families to expect 10- to 10-month deployments for the foreseeable future—a stark contrast from the typical 7-month deployments of recent decades. The Navy’s top enlisted sailor, Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy John Perryman, confirmed that a week later, saying 10-11 months will be the norm for at least a few years. The Micheal Murphy left Hawaii on Dec. 1, 2025, and sailed through the South China Sea and Strait of Malacca before reaching the North Arabian Sea, where it spent the bulk of the deployment, said Cmdr. David Nicolas, who took command of the destroyer a month ago. The Michael Murphy launched Tomahawk missile strikes during Operation Epic Fury and took part in the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Nicolas said. “I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team,” he said. “This is the most resilient crew that I’ve had the pleasure to serve with.” Nicolas previously commanded the Oscar Austin, another guided-missile destroyer. When he handed over the helm to his successor on Sept. 10, he was slated to become an instructor at Surface Warfare Schools in Rhode Island, according to a Navy press release . But a Navy official confirmed to Defense One that his plans were changed when the Michael Murphy’s previous boss, Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham, was relieved on Sept. 27 due to a “loss of confidence” after roughly 11 months in charge.    At Thursday’s homecoming, Petty Officer 3rd Class Jesse Bryson was first off the ship, as the winner of the “first kiss” raffle. Standing with his wife, Arianna Rios, he joked that the deployment involved “a lot of water.” “Join the Navy, see the world—but the world is 70-percent water,” he said with a laugh. But, he added, the crew was great. “I think you could put anyone from this ship on any other ship and they’d stand out,” Bryson said. ]]>

title: Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions?

content:
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？ |海峡时报
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋五月份在北京向媒体发表讲话，他因成为外国情报机构的目标而受到调查。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 10:05
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 10:05
黄仁勋在英伟达的辞职引发了人们的担忧，即美国可能会收紧芯片控制，威胁中国获得先进人工智能计算的机会。
中国称这些间谍指控“毫无根据”，并表示美国正在利用这些指控作为对中国“技术封锁”的借口。
分析师表示，短期内中国人工智能企业面临的压力可能会增加，但这种冲击也可能会加速国内芯片的发展。
北京 — — 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋突然辞职引发了有关中国获取美国先进人工智能芯片的新问题，北京指责华盛顿利用间谍指控为更严格的技术限制辩护，尽管中国分析人士淡化了潜在影响。
黄仁勋曾亲自游说美国总统唐纳德·特朗普放宽对中国芯片销售的限制，他是保持美国技术流向世界第二大经济体的最直言不讳的倡导者之一。
在美国立法者敦促对中国获取先进计算能力进行更严格控制之际，他的离开可能会削弱华盛顿的这种声音，这可能会增加北京推动半导体自给自足的紧迫性。
中国分析师表示，后果可能是双向的——进一步的限制可能会在短期内限制中国人工智能开发商，同时加强对国内替代品的推动，并为华为等中国芯片制造商创造机会。
黄先生于 11 月 12 日辞职，此前他的婚外情被曝光，其中包括一名被美国官员指控与中国情报部门有联系的中国女性。这标志着他 33 年任期的结束，在此期间，他将 Nvidia 打造成全球领先的人工智能芯片供应商。
他长期以来一直认为，将中国排除在美国芯片技术之外会适得其反，会剥夺美国公司的收入，同时鼓励中国竞争对手开发自己的替代品。
自从黄与一名所谓的中国间谍有牵连的消息传出后，中国外交部一再否认这些间谍指控，称这些指控“毫无根据”，是对中国的“抹黑”。美国官员尚未提供证据证明他们的说法。
在11月12日的例行记者会上，中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，美国“应该停止编造中国间谍故事作为实施技术封锁的借口”，并补充说，中国的技术进步是由自主创新和开放合作驱动的。
中国官方媒体《环球时报》也批评了其所称的对美国科技公司日益增长的政治干预，认为黄的离职反映出越来越多地利用国家安全担忧来限制涉及中国的商业决策。
复旦大学美国研究中心主任吴心伯淡化了这对中国人工智能雄心的潜在影响，他表示，中国已经致力于发展自己的半导体能力，无论华盛顿是否

Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions? | The Straits Times
Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions?
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, seen here addressing media in Beijing in May, is being investigated for being the target of a foreign intelligence operation.
Published Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Jensen Huang’s resignation at Nvidia has raised fears that the US may tighten chip controls, threatening China’s access to advanced AI computing.
China called the spy claims “purely unsubstantiated” and said the US is using them as a pretext for “technology blockades” against China.
Analysts said pressure on Chinese AI firms may grow in the short term, but the shock could also speed up domestic chip development.
BEIJING – The abrupt resignation of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has raised fresh questions about China’s access to advanced American artificial intelligence chips, with Beijing accusing Washington of using espionage allegations to justify tighter technology restrictions even as Chinese analysts play down the potential fallout.
Huang, who personally lobbied US President Donald Trump to ease restrictions on chip sales to China, was among the most vocal advocates for keeping American technology flowing to the world’s second-largest economy.
His departure now threatens to weaken that voice in Washington at a time when US lawmakers are pressing for stricter controls on China’s access to advanced computing power, potentially adding urgency to Beijing’s push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.
Chinese analysts said the consequences could cut both ways – further restrictions may constrain Chinese AI developers in the short term, while strengthening the push for domestic alternatives and creating opportunities for Chinese chipmakers such as Huawei.
Huang’s Nov 12 resignation followed revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a Chinese woman alleged by US officials to have links to Chinese intelligence. It marked the end of his 33-year tenure during which he built Nvidia into the world’s leading supplier of the chips that power AI.
He had long argued that excluding China from American chip technology would be counterproductive and would deprive US companies of revenue while encouraging Chinese competitors to develop their own alternatives.
Since news of Huang’s involvement with an alleged Chinese spy broke, China’s Foreign Ministry has repeatedly rejected the espionage allegations, calling them “purely unsubstantiated” and “smears” against China. US officials have not provided evidence for their claims.
At a regular press briefing on Nov 12, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said the US “should stop fabricating the Chinese spy narratives as a pretext for imposing technology blockades,” adding that China’s technological progress is driven by independent innovation and open cooperation.
Chinese state media Global Times also criticised what it described as growing political interference in American technology companies, arguing that Huang’s departure reflected the increasing use of national security concerns to constrain commercial decisions involving China.
Wu Xinbo, director of Fudan University’s Centre for American Studies, played down the potential impact on China’s AI ambitions, saying that China was already committed to developing its own semiconductor capabilities, regardless of whether Washington relaxed or tightened its restrictions.
He pointed to competing views within China over whether to continue purchasing American chips, which still offered performance advantages, or concentrate on developing domestic alternatives.
“If the US tightens its restrictions on chip export controls, which seems likely, it would strengthen the latter camp and benefit Chinese chipmakers,” said Wu, who advises China’s Foreign Ministry.
“The message sent is that the US cannot be relied upon, it can tighten restrictions at any time so we still have to depend on ourselves.”
More fundamentally, Wu said that China and the US were increasingly competing on different fronts. The US is more focused on producing the most advanced AI models, chips and computing capabilities, while Beijing places greater emphasis on commercialising AI and integrating it into manufacturing, healthcare and everyday life.
Zhu Feng, dean of the School of International Studies at Nanjing University, told ST that greater determination to develop domestic alternatives would not immediately close the technological gap.
No impact on chip supply, partnerships amid resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang: Singtel
Why is Nvidia king of the AI chip hill and how soon can rivals catch up?
While tighter restrictions could accelerate investment in domestic alternatives, they would not immediately eliminate China’s dependence on foreign chips, he said. This is because China would not be able to match the capabilities of leading companies such as Nvidia, Taiwan’s TSMC and South Korea’s SK Hynix in the short term, he added.
“Pressure on China will certainly increase in the short term, but in the medium to long term, much depends on whether China can keep its composure and achieve further technological breakthroughs of its own,” he said.
Since 2022, the US government has barred Nvidia from selling its most advanced chips to China. However, in 2025, Trump allowed Nvidia to sell H20 chips to China on a case-by-case basis, and later extended it to Nvidia’s H200 chips.
On Nov 13, shares of Chinese tech companies such as Alibaba, Tencent and Z.ai took a hit as Nvidia’s leadership crisis raised fears that Washington could further tighten restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI computing.
Although Washington restricts direct exports of Nvidia’s top AI chips to China, Chinese companies are still able to rent such advanced computing power from overseas data centres.
In a commentary published on Nov 13 after Huang’s resignation, Global Times warned that other technology executives could face similar scrutiny if their business interests conflicted with Washington’s political agenda.
It also argued that Huang’s Chinese heritage and his calls for continued chip exports had made him particularly vulnerable to political suspicion.

Nanjing University’s Zhu warned that the allegations could fuel a new wave of anti-Chinese sentiment in American political and business circles.
He said the controversy could accelerate efforts by some in Washington to sever technological ties with China, extending beyond chip export controls to broader restrictions on cooperation at a time when advances in AI require both competition and dialogue.
“Whether this will lead to a new Cold War in the field of AI remains to be seen,” he said.
Michelle Ng is China correspondent at The Straits Times. She is interested in Chinese foreign policies, property trends, demographics, education and rural issues.

流亡柬埔寨政客以镇压为由谴责法语国家峰会海峡时报
流亡柬埔寨政客谴责法语国家峰会，称镇压
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日，晚上 08:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 08:04 PM
曼谷，11月13日 - 流亡的柬埔寨反对派人士桑兰西谴责包括法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在内的领导人本周末在金边举行的聚会是“骗局”，称这个东南亚国家的政治迫害和有组织犯罪使其成为不合适的场所。
国家元首和高级部长正在柬埔寨首都举行法语国家国际组织（OIF）峰会。该组织促进法语国家之间的合作，并将和平、民主和人权列为其核心原则。
“我认为峰会将在错误的时间、错误的地点举行，”兰西周五在巴黎通过电话告诉路透社。他逃离柬埔寨后过着自我流放的生活，在柬埔寨他被缺席定罪多项罪行，他的政党也被取缔。
“柬埔寨在民主、法治、人权、司法独立方面处于非常困难的境地……这完全违背了法语国家应代表的价值观，”他说。 “我认为这是一场骗局。这是一次奇怪的峰会。”
柬埔寨新闻部长内斯·菲克特拉 (Neth Pheaktra) 表示，政府“没有时间争论”，专注于使这次会议取得成功。
周一，联合国驻柬埔寨人权特使汤姆·安德鲁斯敦促政府在峰会前释放 100 多名因“行使基本自由”而被拘留的人，其中包括环保活动人士。他表示，这样做将尊重 OIF 的价值观。
由 26 个柬埔寨组织组成的联盟本周向加拿大和法国驻金边大使馆提交了一份联合请愿书，理由是“民主倒退、侵犯人权和对公民社会的攻击”。它呼吁参加峰会的国家抗议“迅速恶化的局势”。
爱丽舍宫的一名官员告诉路透社，法国在峰会上“要传达信息”，人权和法治问题正在“各个层面”得到解决。
这位官员表示：“空席政策并不是推动这些问题取得进展的最佳方式。”
强人洪森统治柬埔寨近四十年，直到 2023 年将权力移交给他的儿子洪马内。他保留了相当大的影响力，包括作为执政的柬埔寨人民党的领导人。
人权组织表示，政治镇压仍在继续，政府压制异见人士、独立媒体和民间社会。
柬埔寨也已成为价值数十亿美元的网络欺诈行业的中心，犯罪集团（主要是华人）建立了庞大的诈骗场所，由被贩运的工人组成，被迫诈骗世界各地的人们。政府去年发起了打击行动，但批评人士表示，它未能针对与该行业相关的有权势精英。
另一位流亡柬埔寨政治家穆索楚亚表示：“当犯罪网络逍遥法外、公民的民主权利被剥夺时，法语国家就无法可信地促进共同繁荣。”路透社

Exiled Cambodian politician denounces Francophonie summit, citing repression
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
BANGKOK, Nov 13 - Exiled Cambodian opposition figure Sam Rainsy denounced a gathering of leaders, including French President Emmanuel Macron, in Phnom Penh this weekend as a "sham", saying political persecution and organised crime in the Southeast Asian nation made it an inappropriate venue.
Heads of state and senior ministers are meeting in the Cambodian capital for a summit of the International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF). The organisation promotes cooperation between French-speaking nations and lists peace, democracy and human rights among its core tenets.
"I think the summit is going to take place at the wrong place at the wrong time," Rainsy told Reuters on Friday by phone from Paris. He lives in self-exile after fleeing Cambodia, where he has been convicted of multiple offences in absentia and his political party has been banned.
"Cambodia is in a very difficult situation in terms of democracy, the rule of law, human rights, independence of the judiciary...which is totally contrary to the values that the Francophonie is supposed to represent," he said. "I think it is a sham. It is a strange summit."
Neth Pheaktra, Cambodia's minister of information, said the government had "no time for polemics" and was focused on making the gathering a success.
On Monday, Tom Andrews, the United Nations' human rights envoy to Cambodia, urged the government to release more than 100 people detained for "exercising their fundamental freedoms", including environmental activists, before the summit. He said doing so would honor the OIF's values.
A coalition of 26 Cambodian organisations this week handed the Canadian and French embassies in Phnom Penh a joint petition citing "democratic backsliding, human rights violations, and attacks on civil society". It called on states attending the summit to protest the "rapidly deteriorating situation".
An Elysee official told Reuters that France had "messages to convey" at the summit and that human rights and rule of law were being addressed "at all levels".
"The policy of the empty chair is not the best way to move these issues forward," the official said.
Strongman Hun Sen governed Cambodia for nearly four decades until 2023, when he handed power to his son, Hun Manet. He retains considerable influence, including as head of the ruling Cambodian People's Party.
Rights groups say political repression has continued, with the government stifling dissent, independent media and civil society.
Cambodia has also become an epicenter of the multibillion-dollar cyberfraud industry, as criminal syndicates, mostly of Chinese origin, have built sprawling scam compounds staffed by trafficked workers forced to defraud people worldwide. The government launched a crackdown last year, but critics say it has failed to target powerful elites linked to the industry.
“The Francophonie cannot credibly promote shared prosperity while criminal networks operate with impunity and citizens are denied their democratic rights,” said Mu Sochua, another exiled Cambodian politician. REUTERS

title: President Trump says Apple’s Tim Cook is the only man to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示，苹果公司的蒂姆·库克是唯一接替黄仁勋出任英伟达首席执行官的人
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，因婚外情被曝光，黄仁勋已辞职
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，黄仁勋因与一名涉嫌中国情报人员的 Megaspeed 高管发生婚外情以及与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生婚外情而辞职。执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将在公司寻找替代者期间担任临时首席执行官。当然，潜在的继任者候选人的名字已经浮出水面，其中包括苹果首席硬件官约翰尼·斯鲁吉(Johny Srouji)。由于英伟达处于全球人工智能爆发的中心，黄仁勋和特朗普的关系密切，经常成为新闻头条。特朗普此前曾形容黄仁勋对于关税和废除拜登总统的人工智能扩散规则的看法“非常有远见”。正在发生的黄事件丑闻中提到了特朗普总统的名字。值得注意的是，据称，虽然美国
情报认为黄仁勋是中国蜜罐行动的目标，有报道称特朗普总统已听取了此事的简报，但选择不对这些信息采取任何行动，以免影响英伟达的销售或与中国对抗。国会已传唤黄仁勋出席中共特别委员会，议员们威胁如果黄仁勋不同意自愿参加闭门会议，将向他发出传票。蒂姆·库克目前担任苹果公司董事会执行主席，曾于 2011 年至 2026 年担任该公司首席执行官。在他任职期间，他负责监督 Apple Music 和 Apple TV 等众多 Apple 服务的推出，同时扩展到 Apple Watch 和 AirPods 等新产品类别。周三开盘时，英伟达股价暴跌超过 10 个百分点，但由于交易员希望利用英伟达股价下跌的机会，该公司股价收复了大部分失地。该公司将于下周（即 11 月 17 日星期二）公布 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩。

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump has said that retired Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, just hours after it was announced that the latter had resigned in the wake of a series of scandals. Taking to his Truth Social platform, the President said , "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP." Nvidia's board of directors announced on Wednesday that Huang had resigned following the revelation that he conducted an extramarital affair with a Megaspeed executive suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset , and a further affair with Nvidia Vice President of Health Care, Kimberly Powell. Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will serve as Interim CEO while the company looks for a replacement. Naturally, names have been floated as potential successor candidates, including Apple's Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji. With Nvidia at the center of the global explosion in AI, Huang and Trump have enjoyed a close relationship that routinely makes news headlines. Trump previously described Huang as 'utterly visionary' in regard to his views on tariffs and rescinding President Biden's AI Diffusion Rule . President Trump's name has been mentioned in the ongoing Huang affair scandal. Notably, it is alleged that while U.S. intelligence believed that Huang had been the target of a Chinese honeypot operation , reports claim that President Trump was briefed on the matter but chose not to do anything with the information, so as not to affect Nvidia's sales or antagonize China. Congress has summoned Jensen Huang to appear before the Select Committee on the CCP , with lawmakers threatening to issue Huang with a subpoena if he doesn't agree to attend a closed-door meeting voluntarily. Tim Cook is currently the Executive Chair of Apple's board, having served as the company's CEO from 2011 to 2026. During his tenure, he oversaw the launch of a plethora of Apple services, including Apple Music and Apple TV, while expanding into new product categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods. Nvidia's share price plunged more than 10 percentage points at the open on Wednesday, but recovered much of that ground as traders looked to take advantage of the dip in Nvidia's share price. The company will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results next week, on Tuesday, November 17.

content:
日本和菲律宾签署石油储备合作协议 - 日本时报
日本与菲律宾签署石油储备合作协议
预计工业部长 Ryosei Akazawa 将在周二于马尼拉举行的亚洲零排放共同体框架峰会之前签署一份关于加强菲律宾石油储存合作的谅解备忘录。 |集集

日本和菲律宾预计将签署一份关于加强东南亚国家石油储备合作的谅解备忘录。
根据该伙伴关系，日本的公共和私营部门将帮助菲律宾建立国家石油储备系统，作为加强其能源安全措施的一部分。
该谅解备忘录定于下周初由工业部长 Ryosei Akazawa 和一名菲律宾官员在周二于马尼拉举行的亚洲零排放共同体框架峰会之前签署。
由于中东局势日益动荡，菲律宾于三月宣布国家能源紧急状态，此后一直致力于增强其石油供应的弹性。
该备忘录将涵盖与沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋等产油国合作的联合研究，以及开发建立国家石油储备计划所需的系统。
与此同时，日本工程公司千代田株式会社预计将很快与菲律宾国家石油公司签署关于石油储备设施技术援助的谅解备忘录。
日本的亚洲广泛能源和资源弹性伙伴关系（POWERR Asia）是一个于 4 月宣布的框架，旨在向亚洲国家提供约 100 亿美元的财政援助，以增强其能源供应网络，该框架被视为这些措施的可能资金来源。
与日本一样，菲律宾90%以上的原油进口依赖中东。截至5月3日，该国持有的石油储备仅相当于53天的国内消费量，远低于日本公共和私营部门能够满足207天需求的石油储备。
中东主要石油运输水道霍尔木兹海峡事实上关闭后，菲律宾经历了燃料短缺和供应混乱，目前正在努力建立国家石油储备系统，同时增加私营部门的库存。
该国计划在2027年及以后建设国家储备储罐，最终目标是增加石油储量1500万桶，相当于30天的消耗量。

Japan and Philippines to ink deal on oil reserve cooperation - The Japan Times
Japan and Philippines to ink deal on oil reserve cooperation
Industry minister Ryosei Akazawa is expected to sign a memorandum of understanding on strengthening cooperation on oil stockpiling in the Philippines, ahead of a summit of the Asia Zero Emission Community framework in Manila on Tuesday. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Japan and the Philippines are expected to sign a memorandum of understanding on strengthening cooperation on oil stockpiling in the Southeast Asian country.
Under the partnership, Japan’s public and private sectors will help the Philippines develop a national oil reserve system as part of measures to enhance its energy security.
The MOU is set to be signed early next week by industry minister Ryosei Akazawa and a Philippine official ahead of a summit of the Asia Zero Emission Community framework in Manila on Tuesday.
The Philippines declared a state of national energy emergency in March amid growing turmoil in the Middle East and has since been working to bolster the resilience of its oil supply.
The memorandum will cover a joint study on cooperating with oil-producing countries such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates as well as the development of systems needed to establish a national oil reserve plan.
Meanwhile, Japanese engineering firm Chiyoda Corp. is expected to sign an MOU with Philippine National Oil soon on technological assistance for oil reserve facilities.
Japan’s Partnership on Wide Energy and Resources Resilience Asia, or POWERR Asia, a framework announced in April to provide about $10 billion in financial aid to Asian countries for enhancing their energy supply networks, is seen as a possible source of funding for the measures.
Like Japan, the Philippines depends on the Middle East for more than 90% of its crude oil imports. As of May 3, the country held reserves of oil equivalent to only 53 days of domestic consumption, far below Japan’s public- and private-sector reserves capable of covering 207 days.
Having experienced fuel shortages and supply confusion following the de facto closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transport waterway in the Middle East, the Philippines is working to establish a national oil reserve system while raising stockpiles at its private sector.
The country plans to construct storage tanks for national reserves for completion in 2027 and later, aiming to eventually increase its oil reserves by 15 million barrels, equivalent to 30 days of consumption.

title: Malaysia and Singapore step up Nvidia AI chip probes amidst Jensen Huang controversy
zh_title: 马来西亚和新加坡在黄仁勋争议中加大对 Nvidia AI 芯片的调查
summary: 由于担心可能规避美国对中国的出口限制，马来西亚和新加坡加强了对人工智能硬件运输的审查。据路透社报道，马来西亚已对命运多舛的 Megaspeed 子公司进口的人工智能硬件是否随后出口到其他国家展开调查。与此同时，据《海峡时报》报道，新加坡已对另一名高管提出指控，指控其购买的 917 台服务器存在问题，这些服务器可能包含 Nvidia 加速器。此前，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因声称拥有多个额外职位而辞职。
content:
由于担心可能规避美国对中国的出口限制，马来西亚和新加坡加强了对人工智能硬件运输的审查。据路透社报道，马来西亚已对命运多舛的 Megaspeed 子公司进口的人工智能硬件是否随后出口到其他国家展开调查。与此同时，据《海峡时报》报道，新加坡已对另一名高管提出指控，指控其购买的 917 台服务器存在问题，这些服务器可能包含 Nvidia 加速器。在此消息发布之前，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因声称自己有多次婚外情而辞职，其中包括与一名可能协助 GPU 走私到中国的中国情报人员发生婚外情。分析人士推测，系统性芯片走私可能是他离职的原因。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：台积电） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释说，马来西亚投资、贸易和工业部正在研究是否总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed 的马来西亚子公司 Speedmatrix 重新出口了其进口的所有人工智能处理器和服务器，供当地数据中心使用。
显然，经过数月的调查，当局尚未查明是否发生过此类运输，如果发生过，是否符合马来西亚法律。马来西亚于 2025 年 7 月对美国开发的先进人工智能加速器的出口、过境和转运实施了限制，因此现在要求公司获得适当的许可证。马来西亚外交部表示，正在与海关当局以及新加坡和美国的官员合作，并可能推出额外的限制。总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，没有证据表明与 Megaspeed 相关的人工智能硬件已离开马来西亚，但他承诺配合国际调查。据 DigiTimes 报道，谈到 Megaspeed，该公司于 11 月 12 日表示，已聘请一家美国律师事务所对其 AI GPU 进行全面清查，并独立评估其对美国出口管制法规的遵守情况。该公司还证实，已配合美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）的检查，并准备在必要时与其他美国政府机构合作。 Megaspeed 首席执行官 James Tan Yong Pong 强调，遵守美国出口规则以及透明运营始终是该公司的首要任务。
不过，Megaspeed没有透露其拥有多少GPU、有哪些GPU型号、BIS在检查时检查了哪些内容，也没有透露当局是否发现任何违规行为。 与此同时，新加坡当局已对曾担任Superphi董事、NJ Global Financial首席运营官的34岁中国公民石秉哲提出41项刑事指控。检察官称，这两家公司在 2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 2 月期间通过 41 笔交易从 Aperia International 购买了 917 台包含受限 Nvidia 硬件的服务器。当局声称，这些公司有理由相信这些服务器与 Aperia International 的犯罪活动有关。 Superphi现在面临

【原文 English Original】
Malaysia and Singapore have intensified scrutiny of AI hardware shipments amid concerns about the potential circumvention of U.S. export restrictions on China. Malaysia has launched an investigation into whether AI hardware imported by a subsidiary of the ill-fated Megaspeed was subsequently exported to other countries, reports Reuters . Meanwhile, Singapore has charged another executive over questionable purchases of 917 servers that may contain Nvidia accelerators, according to The Straits Times . The news follows the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over claims he had multiple extra-marital affairs , including with a possible Chinese intelligence asset who facilitated GPU smuggling into China. Analysts speculate that systematic chip smuggling may be the reason behind his departure . Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry is examining whether Speedmatrix, the Malaysian subsidiary of Singapore-based Megaspeed , re-exported any of the AI processors and servers it had imported for use in local data centers. Apparently, after months of investigating, authorities have yet to find out whether any such shipments occurred and, if they did, whether they complied with Malaysian laws. Malaysia introduced restrictions on the export, transit, and trans-shipment of advanced U.S.-developed AI accelerators in July 2025, so it now requires companies to obtain appropriate permits. The Malaysian ministry said it was cooperating with customs authorities as well as officials in Singapore and the U.S., and could introduce additional restrictions. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said there was no evidence that Megaspeed-related AI hardware had left Malaysia, but he promised to cooperate with international investigations. Speaking of Megaspeed, the company said on November 12 that it had hired a U.S. law firm to conduct a comprehensive inventory of its AI GPUs and independently assess its compliance with U.S. export-control regulations, reports DigiTimes . The company also confirmed that it had cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and was prepared to cooperate with other U.S. government agencies if necessary. James Tan Yong Pong, chief executive of Megaspeed, stressed that compliance with U.S. export rules as well as transparent operations were always a priority for the company. However, Megaspeed did not disclose how many GPUs it owns and which GPU models it has, what BIS examined during its inspections, or whether the authorities had identified any violations. Meanwhile, Singaporean authorities have brought 41 criminal charges against Shi Bingzhe, a 34-year-old Chinese citizen who served as director of Superphi and chief operating officer of NJ Global Financial. The two companies purchased 917 servers containing restricted Nvidia hardware from Aperia International in 41 transactions between May 2024 and February 2025, according to prosecutors. Authorities allege that the companies had reason to believe the servers were linked to criminal activity by Aperia International. Superphi now faces six charges, while NJ Global Financial faces 35. The latest charges expand a case that now involves five individuals and six companies. Four firms — Aperia International, A-Speed Infotech, Aperia Cloud Services (II), and Luxuriate Your Life — were charged in July over allegedly making false claims when purchasing servers. Meanwhile, the exact nature of those claims was not disclosed in the report. Authorities have frozen the disposal of a property worth approximately S$55 million and confiscated around S$1 million from bank accounts. Shi faces up to 10 years in prison and a fine of S$500,000 per charge if convicted. His next court appearance is scheduled for January 4, 2027. The two cases largely highlight the significance of Malaysia and Singapore in the supply chain of restricted AI hardware to places where it should not be, such as China. Singapore's investigation focuses on alleged fraud and transactions involving proceeds of criminal activity, whereas Malaysia seeks to find out whether imported AI equipment was subsequently shipped abroad in violation of local regulations. Neither investigation has found that the hardware ultimately reached China, but both illustrate difficulties that authorities face as they attempt to enforce restrictions on advanced AI hardware across international supply chains.

zh_title: 从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴
summary: 从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴海峡时报 从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴 立即注册：深入了解亚洲快速发展的发展 文件照片：Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 12 月 3 日抵达美国华盛顿特区国会山与参议院银行委员会举行会议。路透社/Evelyn Hockstein/文件照片于 2026 年 11 月 14 日发布03:04 AM 2026 年 11 月 14 日更新，11 月 13 日凌晨 03:09 - 黄仁勋作为宝莱坞日场偶像，作为《黑客帝国》中的角色或穿着红色天鹅绒套装
content:
从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴海峡时报
从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
文件照片：Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 12 月 3 日抵达美国华盛顿特区国会山参加参议院银行委员会会议。REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein/文件照片
发表于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:09
11 月 13 日 - 黄仁勋扮演宝莱坞日场偶像、《黑客帝国》中的角色，或者在平行宇宙版《上床的间谍》海报上穿上红色天鹅绒套装：这位 Nvidia 联合创始人的婚外情，包括与一名中国女商人的婚外情，本周在互联网上引起了轩然大波。
人工智能的风暴生成了视频和图像，其中许多剪辑可能是在英伟达图形芯片的帮助下制作的，这为科技行业最著名的首席执行官之一倒台、抹去了数千亿投资者价值并引发全球调查的丑闻提供了一些缓解。
在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普任命史蒂芬·米勒为办公厅主任（周一生效）后，黄的表情包与包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断超过 12 小时的一系列搞笑表情包争夺了聚光灯，并以最新的斯蒂芬·米勒吸血鬼表情包拉开了一周的序幕。
但 RaviKunvariyaX 在 X 上打趣道，围绕黄仁勋退出 Nvidia 的危机的幽默主导了许多社交媒体的动态，其中许多剪辑可能是使用 Nvidia 图形芯片制作的。
“詹森实际上是在为基础设施提供资金、销售硬件并收取收入，而互联网则使用他自己的技术来欺骗他，”该用户说。
一张广为流传的图片显示，身穿 Nvidia 衬衫的黄仁勋转身避开 OpenAI、谷歌 Gemini 和 DeepSeek 等人工智能模型的标志，然后指着一名贴有“中国模型”标签的女性，这是对围绕他辞职的指控的戏谑。
《X》上的一则讽刺作品将黄仁勋和黄爱丽的脸放在经典情景喜剧《三人行》的片头字幕上，该剧讲述了一个男人和两个女室友的故事。
其他内容包括一段由人工智能生成的视频，观看次数达数百万次，其中主角是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，以及其他描述这家芯片巨头幕后表面上发生的事情的视频。本周大部分时间，Nvidia 都是 Reddit 和 X 等热门平台的热门话题之一。
包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断了超过 12 个小时，导致一些企业争先恐后地抢购传真机、电话和纸张，这为本周晚些时候的表情包工厂增添了新的素材。
X 用户 omgsidewalks 发帖称，“不着急。慢慢来……周五快乐。”一篇被广泛转发的帖子写道，署名是“每一位公司员工”。 X 帖子的观看次数超过 400 万次。
其他模因想象微软备受诟病的 90 年代虚拟助手“Clippy”的角色，要么导致或解释了这次中断。
微软的服务一直是一个重复的模因主题，包括在 2024 年因 CrowdStrike 更新错误引发全球 IT 中断、导致 Windows 机器崩溃之后。
“每年，微软都应该关闭 Outlook 一个下午，这样我们就可以出去和朋友一起玩了:)，”另一篇获得数千次浏览的 X 帖子中写道。路透社

Nov 13 - Jensen Huang as a Bollywood matinee idol, as a character from "The Matrix" or donning a red velvet suit on a poster for an alternate-universe version of "The Spy Who Shagged Me": the Nvidia co-founder's extramarital affairs, including with a Chinese businesswoman, set the Internet afire this week.
The storm of AI generated video and images, many of the clips were likely made with the help of Nvidia graphics chips, provided some light relief to a scandal that toppled one of the tech industry's most prominent CEOs, wiping out hundreds of billions of investor value and triggering investigations worldwide.
The Huang memes competed for the spotlight with a raft of comedic takes on the more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams, topping off a week that kicked off with the latest Stephen Miller vampire memes after U.S. President Donald Trump named him as chief of staff, effective Monday.
But it was humor on the crisis surrounding Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia that dominated many social media feeds, with many of the clips likely made using Nvidia graphics chips, RaviKunvariyaX quipped on X.
"Jensen is literally funding the infrastructure, selling the hardware, and collecting revenue while the internet uses his own technology to troll him," the user said.
One widely shared image showed Jensen Huang in an Nvidia shirt turning away from logos for AI models including OpenAI, Google's Gemini and DeepSeek, then pointing at a woman labeled "Chinese Model," a play on the allegations surrounding his resignation.
A satire on X placed Jensen Huang and Alice Huang's faces over those of actors in the opening credits of the classic sit-com "Three's Company," about a man with two female roommates.
Others included an AI-generated video with millions of views featuring US President Donald Trump, along others depicting what ostensibly happened behind the scenes at the chip giant. Nvidia was among the trending topics in popular platforms such as Reddit and X for most of this week.
A more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services, including Outlook and Teams, that sent some business scrambling for fax machines, phones and paper added fresh fodder for the meme factories late in the week.
"No rush. Take your time ... Happy Friday," read one widely shared post, signed "Every corporate employee," X user omgsidewalks posted. The X post was viewed over 4 million times.
Other memes imagined a role for Microsoft's much maligned 'Clippy' 90s-era virtual helper either causing or explaining the outage.
Microsoft's services have been a repeat meme subject, including after a global IT outage in 2024 triggered by a faulty CrowdStrike update, that crashed Windows machines.
"every year, microsoft should turn off outlook for an afternoon so we can all go outside and play with out friends :)," read another X post with thousands of views. REUTERS

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因多项事务和中国间谍指控而辞职
summary: 英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “Colette Kress，现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官
content:
英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意担任临时首席执行官。Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时担任临时首席执行官，直至任命永久继任者。董事会正在开始寻找永久首席执行官，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。”最近几周，有报道称黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系过于熟悉，美国情报机构怀疑黄可能是中国情报人员。据报道，这家 AI GPU 巨头的首席执行官可能成为间谍阴谋的目标——Megaspeed 因参与向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的出口管制 AI GPU 而受到调查。
消息传出后，英伟达股价在早盘交易中暴跌逾 10%，目前上个月跌幅超过 23%。 周末，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子不忠，并在全公司范围内道歉。另外，鉴于黄仁勋在全球人工智能革命中的作用，英伟达董事会对有关黄仁勋的卷入可能涉及国家安全问题的报道发起了独立调查。 Colette Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起担任 Nvidia 执行副总裁兼首席财务官；在此之前，她在思科和微软等公司工作了 25 年。几天后，第二个爆炸性报道出现，声称黄仁勋还与他在公司的直接下属之一鲍威尔有恋情。有报道称，这件事在公司内部是众所周知的，两人甚至被拍到在 Nvidia GTC 的圣何塞酒店里亲热。据称，安全人员隔离了一名旁观者，该旁观者用摄像机拍摄了整个互动过程，并要求该人签署一份保密协议。 Nvidia 还宣布 Harvey C. Jones 将担任公司首任董事会主席；他此前曾担任新思科技 (Synopsys) 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board of directors has confirmed today that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO. The news follows revelations that Huang had been involved in not one but two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another with his direct report, Nvidia’s VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. "NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," the board stated. "Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates." In recent weeks, stories have come to light alleging that Huang was involved in an overly familiar relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect may be a Chinese intelligence asset. It was reported that the AI GPU giant’s CEO may have been the target of a spy plot — Megaspeed is under investigatio n for its involvement in the smuggling of $2 billion worth of export-controlled AI GPUs into China. Nvidia shares plunged more than 10 percent in early market trading following the news, and are now down more than 23% in the last month. Over the weekend, Jensen Huang admitted that he had been unfaithful to his wife and issued a company-wide apology. Separately, Nvidia’s Board of Directors launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang’s entanglement may be a matter of national security, given his role in the global AI revolution. Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and CFO since September 2013; prior to that, she spent 25 years at Cisco and Microsoft, among others. Just a couple of days later, a second bombshell report emerged claiming that Jensen Huang was also romantically involved with Powell , one of his direct reports at the company. Reports indicate the affair was known within the company, and that the two were even filmed being affectionate in a San Jose hotel at Nvidia GTC. Security allegedly sequestered a bystander who filmed the interaction on camera and made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. Nvidia also announced that Harvey C. Jones will serve as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board; he has previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

title: Mass smuggling of up to 1.5 million Nvidia AI GPUs could be the underlying cause of Jensen Huang's departure, analysts claim
zh_title: 分析师称，大规模走私多达 150 万块 Nvidia AI GPU 可能是黄仁勋离职的根本原因
summary: 领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
content:
领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审视了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 超过 1.5 GW 的 Nvidia 硬件受到管制根据 SemiAnalysis 追踪人工智能加速器生产和目的地的加速器模型，近年来美国的出口限制最终最终落到了中国。该估算不包括 Nvidia 为遵守美国出口规则而专门开发的处理器，例如 H20 或 H800。该公司还声称，美国商务部就未经授权的运输规模得出了类似的结论。
Yet, SemiAnalysis does not disclose the exact number of accelerators shipped to China illegally, or their split between Nvidia's product generations.The scale of the alleged diversions is particularly notable because modern AI accelerators require substantial power and infrastructure.虽然该报告没有解释如何将加速器数量转换为功率数据，但该公司很可能使用封装级铭牌/额定功率乘以 GPU 数量。假设所有这些AI GPU都是额定功率高达700W的Nvidia H200 SXM，那么中国大约有214.2万个此类加速器，而如果所有这些处理器都是额定功率高达1,000W的B200 SXM，那么我们谈论的是150万个。对于混合部署，总数将落在这些数字之间，具体取决于 H200 和 B200 加速器的比例。为了将这些数字放在上下文中，xAI 的 Colossus One 拥有 220-230,000 个 Hopper H100 和 H200 GPU，而 Colossus 2 的目标是 120 万个 Blackwell B200 和 B300 GPU。也就是说，中国 1.5 GW 的受限 Nvidia 硬件代表着巨大的计算基础设施数量，与 xAI 现有的整个 Colossus 业务的规模相当甚​​至超过。虽然 SemiAnalysis 没有透露受限制的人工智能加速器到达中华人民共和国的所有案例，但它通过两起著名的涉嫌 GPU 走私案件支持了其评估。
第一个涉及 Supermicro 联合​​创始人 Wally Liaw、台湾销售主管 Steven Chang 和承包商 Willy Sun，他们于 2026 年 3 月被指控。根据起诉书，价值约 25 亿美元的服务器被出售给东南亚的一家公司，价值 5.1 亿美元的设备随后转移到中国并由阿里巴巴获得。检察官指控被告在审计期间使用替代服务器并转移识别标签来隐藏硬件的实际目的地。第二起案件涉及与台湾英伟达、青云、长电、飞虎和超微有关的九名个人。当局指责

【原文 English Original】
Leading semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis believes that Jensen Huang's sudden departure from Nvidia may have been driven not only by revelations about his personal extramarital relationships, but also by widespread illicit exports of advanced AI accelerators to China. In its latest newsletter, analysts estimate that more than 1.5 gigawatts (GW) worth of restricted Nvidia hardware, which could be equivalent to up to 1.5 million GPUs, has reached the country despite U.S. export controls. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Over 1.5 GW of Nvidia hardware subject to U.S. export restrictions ultimately ended up in China in recent years, according to SemiAnalysis' Accelerator Model, which tracks AI accelerator production and destinations. The estimate excludes processors that Nvidia specifically developed to comply with U.S. export rules, such as the H20 or H800. The firm also claims that the U.S. Department of Commerce has reached a similar conclusion about the scale of unauthorized shipments. Yet, SemiAnalysis does not disclose the exact number of accelerators shipped to China illegally, or their split between Nvidia's product generations. The scale of the alleged diversions is particularly notable because modern AI accelerators require substantial power and infrastructure. While the report does not explain how it converts accelerator quantities into power figures, it is likely that the company uses package-level nameplate/rated power multiplied by the number of GPUs. Assuming that all of these AI GPUs were Nvidia H200 SXM rated for up to 700W, then China got around 2.142 million of such accelerators, while if all of these processors were B200 SXM rated for up to 1,000W, then we are talking about 1.5 million units. For a mixed deployment, the total would fall between these figures, depending on the proportion of H200 and B200 accelerators. To put these numbers into context, xAI's Colossus One had 220-230,000 Hopper H100 and H200 GPUs, whereas the Colossus 2 has a target of 1.2 million Blackwell B200 and B300 GPUs. That said, 1.5 GW of restricted Nvidia hardware in China represents an enormous amount of computing infrastructure, which is comparable, or even exceeds, the scale of xAI's entire existing Colossus operation. While SemiAnalysis did not reveal all the cases in which restricted AI accelerators reached the People's Republic of China, it supports its assessment with two well-known cases of alleged GPU smuggling. The first involves Supermicro co-founder Wally Liaw, Taiwan sales executive Steven Chang, and contractor Willy Sun, who were charged in March 2026. According to the indictment, approximately $2.5 billion worth of servers were sold to a company in Southeast Asia, with $510 million worth of equipment subsequently diverted to China and obtained by Alibaba . Prosecutors allege that the defendants used substitute servers and transferred identification labels to conceal the actual destinations of the hardware during audits. The second case involves nine individuals associated with Nvidia, Albatron, Chief Telecom, Flying Tiger, and Supermicro in Taiwan. The authorities accuse the group of arranging unauthorized exports of 130 Nvidia B300-based servers, 74 of which eventually reached China. The suspects used shell companies, forged documents, and declared Japan as the destination for servers that were actually bound for China, according to prosecutors. Taiwanese authorities discovered the operation during a drug smuggling investigation. Both cases are still before the courts. Amidst the ongoing fallout and reports into Jensen's Huang's extramarital affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence asset who was an executive at Megaspeed, one report claims that Ms. Huang was personally responsible for facilitating the smuggling of $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI hardware into China , around 240,000 GPUs, mostly H100 and H200 models. The right timing? SemiAnalysis suggests that the scale of these violations may explain why Huang's personal conduct became a major issue at this very point in time. The company's analysts speculate that some members of the U.S. intelligence community sought to remove Jensen Huang because he opposed more aggressive restrictions on China's access to American AI hardware. However, the report provides no direct evidence that intelligence agencies influenced Nvidia's board or that Huang participated in unauthorized exports. The timing also coincides with congressional efforts to advance the Remote Access Security Act (RASA), which passed the House of Representatives on January 12. The legislation is meant to extend U.S. export-control authority to remote access to advanced AI hardware hosted outside China, including data centers in Europe and the Middle East. SemiAnalysis reports that Nvidia and Oracle have actively opposed the proposal. The analysts believe that Huang's departure essentially removes an influential opponent of stricter restrictions and accelerates efforts to block Chinese companies from accessing American AI hardware in the cloud. However, SemiAnalysis warns that truly all-inclusive restrictions could encourage Chinese developers to adopt domestic accelerators (something that Jensen Huang has consistently warned about), undermine international AI software collaboration, and ultimately weaken American high-tech companies. Continued Chinese access to American AI accelerators offers several advantages to the U.S. technology industry, according to SemiAnalysis. Firstly, it generates revenue for American companies such as AMD, Nvidia, and cloud service providers. Secondly, when Chinese companies rent GPU capacity from data centers outside China, U.S. authorities retain the ability to monitor their activities and potentially terminate access if necessary due to national security concerns. Thirdly, prolonged reliance on American hardware reduces incentives for Chinese developers to adopt domestic AI accelerators, which could eventually compete with AMD and Nvidia in international markets. Another important aspect is the contribution of Chinese developers to the global software ecosystem. On the one hand, Chinese laboratories have developed open-source technologies such as DeepEP, DeepGEMM, and MSA, which improve the efficiency of AI workloads on Nvidia hardware and benefit developers worldwide. In addition, American companies also depend on Chinese engineers, component suppliers, and manufacturers. Therefore, legal curbs that completely restrict Chinese developers' access to American AI accelerators could undermine international cooperation, reduce availability of open-source optimizations, and encourage Chinese companies to develop software specifically for domestic hardware. On the other hand, access to advanced AI accelerators from AMD or Nvidia enables Chinese laboratories to develop increasingly sophisticated AI models, which will rival leading-edge models developed in America and perhaps create national security risks. To that end, SemiAnalysis acknowledges the need to limit China's access to advanced AI accelerators from U.S.-based companies, as they could, among other things, be used to develop weapons of mass destruction or undermine American national security in different ways. Yet, SA analysts argue that restrictions should focus on the amount and capabilities of hardware available to Chinese entities rather than completely prohibit any access. SemiAnalysis seems to favor a system in which Chinese developers can rent computing capacity from trusted providers outside China under U.S. oversight. Such an approach could preserve American technological influence and commercial benefits and limit China's ability to acquire advanced AI infrastructure independently.

title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

Published Nov 13, 2026, 11:19 PM

BEIJING, Nov 13 - China is willing to expand cooperation with South Korea in traditional and emerging sectors including artificial intelligence and biomedicine, Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Friday.
• In a meeting with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun, Wang said the two countries are "close neighbours that cannot be moved away" and "maintaining good-neighbourliness and friendship is the right choice for both sides," according to a statement released by China's Foreign Ministry
• The South Korean diplomat is on a two-day visit to China starting Friday
• China-South Korea relations were "back onto the right track" after their leaders' exchanges since late last year, Wang said
• Ties soured under Yoon Suk Yeol, the predecessor of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who drew Seoul closer to Washington and Tokyo
• Lee, who took office in June 2025, has sought to restore relations, hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Gyeongju in late 2025 and making a state visit to China in January
• China is willing to further enhance mutual trust with South Korea and expand their common interests, Wang said
• Next week, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will visit China and attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting in Shenzhen REUTERS
